literal.prompt: Какая игра Дэвида Брэбена и Иэна Белла 1984 года сочетала космическую торговлю, повышение боевого рейтинга и каркасную трёхмерную графику?

literalGroups.primaryGround: ACMI L50-L52 states Elite was written/developed by David Braben and Ian Bell, published September 1984, as space trading; L51 names the combat-rating goal; L52 identifies early wire-frame 3D graphics with hidden-line removal.
literalGroups.locator: ACMI L50-L52 states Elite was written/developed by David Braben and Ian Bell, published September 1984, as space trading; L51 names the combat-rating goal; L52 identifies early wire-frame 3D graphics with hidden-line removal.

literalGroups.literal: Правильный ответ — Elite. Её открытая космическая модель сочетала торговлю с развитием боевого рейтинга, а каркасная 3D-графика была одной из первых среди домашних компьютерных игр.
literalGroups.primaryGround: ACMI L50 says its open-ended model and 3D graphics led to wide home-computer ports and genre-maker status; L52 identifies the early wire-frame 3D implementation.
literalGroups.locator: ACMI L50 says its open-ended model and 3D graphics led to wide home-computer ports and genre-maker status; L52 identifies the early wire-frame 3D implementation.

literalGroups.literal: В комплекте с Elite шла новелла Роберта Холдстока The Dark Wheel о моральных и правовых кодексах игрового мира.
literalGroups.primaryGround: ACMI L52: The Dark Wheel novella by Robert Holdstock gave players insight into the moral and legal codes they might aspire to.
literalGroups.locator: ACMI L52: The Dark Wheel novella by Robert Holdstock gave players insight into the moral and legal codes they might aspire to.

literalGroups.literal: Копии Rogue попали в 2BSD в начале 1981 года; Rogue 3.6 выпустили отдельно в апреле.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Roguelike Gallery L8 distinguishes early-1981 copies of generic Rogue included in the 2BSD software collection from the separately stated April 1981 release of version 3.6. This note does not assert that the distributed copies were version 3.6.
literalGroups.locator: Roguelike Gallery L7-L8: Rogue was developed around 1980 by Toy/Wichman and Ken Arnold; version 3.6 entered the 2BSD software collection in early 1981 and became popular in university labs.

literalGroups.literal: Zork — текстовое приключение о Великой Подземной Империи, созданное в MIT в 1977 году.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Lantern Hall L21,L26,L28,L55-L56: Zork is a text adventure set in the Great Underground Empire; it was created at MIT in 1977 by members of the Laboratory for Computer Science.
literalGroups.locator: Lantern Hall L21,L26,L28,L55-L56: Zork is a text adventure set in the Great Underground Empire; it was created at MIT in 1977 by members of the Laboratory for Computer Science.

literalGroups.literal: В M.U.L.E. четыре игрока торговали и участвовали в аукционах за одним компьютером.
literalGroups.primaryGround: Museum of Computer Games L17-L20,L28: M.U.L.E. is a 1983 strategy game; Dani Bunten built it around four-player trade and auctions at one computer.
literalGroups.locator: Museum of Computer Games L17-L20,L28: M.U.L.E. is a 1983 strategy game; Dani Bunten built it around four-player trade and auctions at one computer.
